title: Excellent experience
text: Excellent experience. Alex was our guide and was very informative and his attention to detail and also our safety was very good. Would certainly recommend doing this again
author: davemE9004CE

title: Segway is a great activity
text: Alex was an excellent guide very knowledgeable about the history of Barcelona  he was very attentive to both of us on the tour
author: Tina_R

title: Segway tour Barcelona
text: Excellent tour. Great way to see a lot of the city. Riders need to be 16. Guide knowledgeable and a pleasant couple of hours.
author: Barry_J

title: Great personal service
text: Due to the information on the pickup place, we were late getting there.He waited no issues very personable and great individual for knowledge of the area
author: Bob_P

title: Do it
text: Lots of fun. Segways are easy to ride and a great way to see this beautiful city.
author: Leah G

title: Segway tour is a Don't miss event!
text: Let me tell you, Phillip was an awesome guide.  He was very patient with me -- a 61-year-old woman learning to ride a Segway.  It was easy, y'all!  If I can do it -- anybody can!  He was so knowledgeable about Barcelona and I really enjoyed getting to know him.  I have to say this was one of the most enjoyable things I did in Barcelona, so this is a can't miss for you.
author: dwilkins0913

title: Highly recommended
text:
Alex was our guide today. He did a wonderful job.  He was knowledgeable, experienced and friendly.  He even helped us get out of the city through the Metro train because the Taxis were on strike. 
Their segways are in different cities of Europe and we look forward to using them again.
We highly recommend this tour and this vendor.
author: Merlyn_L

title: Fun and practical way to see the city!
text: Segways were fun and practical. Great way to cover a lot of ground. Private tour with our guide (Phil) was great! He was very knowledgeable about the city and its history.
author: hollisg813

title: A fun way to learn about the city with all ages.
text: Excellent adventure around parts of the city with a great guide. Learned alot of interesting facts. Highly recommended, a fun way to explore.
author: Traveler558283

title: Great Experience
text: Outstanding experience.  1st time on a Segway and it was so easy.  Great way to see a lot in a short time.  Our guide Pablo was very knowledgeable and engaging.
author: Ronald_B
